The test image shows a soybean field where the surrounding plants are completely brown/dead (mature/dried), but one central plant has a **green stem and green leaves** while its pods appear mature. This retention of green tissue when surrounding plants have senesced is the hallmark of **Green stem disorder**.

Let me confirm with a reference image.

This reference image is a near-perfect match: green stems with mature/brown pods against a background of fully senesced brown soybean plants. This is exactly what appears in the test image.
